cards.text: Friend, the Feast of Unleavened Bread, called the Passover, is getting close. And the chief priests and the scribes, the temple's top priests and the teachers of the law, are looking for a way to put Jesus to death. But something is holding them back.

cards.question: The chief priests and scribes want Jesus dead, but they're holding back because they feared the ___.

cards.text: Then Satan entered Judas Iscariot, who was one of the Twelve, Jesus's closest disciples. And Judas goes off to meet with the chief priests and the temple officers.

cards.question: Judas meets with the chief priests and temple officers to discuss how he might ___ Jesus to them.

cards.text: So here's a man from Jesus's own inner circle, offering to hand Him over. The chief priests and officers are delighted.

cards.question: The chief priests agree to give Judas money for handing Jesus over.
Judas agrees to the deal. Now he's watching for his moment to betray Jesus to the chief priests. What kind of moment is he waiting for?

answers.text: One in front of the whole temple

cards.text: Then came the day of Unleavened Bread on which the Passover lamb was to be sacrificed. Passover day is HERE, and Jesus has a meal to get ready.

cards.question: Jesus sends two of His disciples, ___ and ___, to go get the Passover ready.

cards.text: Jesus tells them, “Go and make preparations for us to eat the Passover.” And they ask the exact question I'd ask first: “Where do You want us to prepare it?”
Jesus says that when they enter the city, a man will meet them, and they're to follow him to the house he enters. No address, no map, no pin dropped in the group chat, just FOLLOW THAT MAN.

cards.question: In the city, how will Peter and John spot the man Jesus told them to follow?

answers.text: He'll be carrying a jug of water
He'll be leading a young donkey
He'll be holding a lit lamp

cards.text: At the house, they're to tell the owner, “The Teacher asks: Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with My disciples?”

cards.question: Jesus says the owner of the house will show Peter and John a place to prepare the Passover. What is it?

answers.text: A large upper room already furnished
A room in the temple courts
A garden just outside the city

cards.question: When Peter and John get to the city, things turn out a little differently than Jesus said they would.

cards.text: They found it just as Jesus had told them, and they prepared the Passover. Not one wrong turn, not one “recalculating,” and friend, I once got lost inside my own bakery.
When the hour had come, Jesus reclined at the table with His apostles. The Passover is ready. And Jesus has something to tell them.

cards.question: Jesus tells His apostles He has eagerly desired to eat this Passover with them. Before what?

cards.text: He tells them He won't eat it again until it is fulfilled in the kingdom of God. Then, after taking the cup, He gave thanks and said, “Take this and divide it among yourselves.”

cards.question: Passing the cup, Jesus tells His apostles He'll keep drinking the fruit of the vine with them at every Passover from now on.

cards.text: And He took the bread, gave thanks and broke it, and gave it to them.

cards.question: As Jesus hands His apostles the bread, what does He say it is?
With the bread, Jesus tells His apostles to do this to ___ Him.

cards.text: Friend, I've lost a timer while it was BEEPING in my own mustache, but Jesus makes sure this meal is one to remember. In the same way, after supper He took the cup.

cards.question: After supper, Jesus takes the cup. What does He say this cup is?

answers.text: The new covenant in His blood
A reminder of the escape from Egypt
A blessing on the house owner

cards.question: Right after the cup, Jesus tells His apostles that His betrayer is nowhere near this table.

cards.text: Jesus says, “Look! The hand of My betrayer is with Mine on the table.” Then He says, “Indeed, the Son of Man will go as it has been determined, but woe to that man who betrays Him.”

cards.question: After Jesus speaks about His betrayer, the apostles began to ___ among themselves which of them was going to do this.

cards.text: The whole table is asking which of them it could be. And that's where we'll leave it for now, friend, because this story is far from done.
